2609.17317.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
2609.17317.paper_summary: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available at https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE.
2609.17317.paper_summary_zh: 使用 LLM 來完成在線調查會影響基於調查的研究的有效性，但檢測此類使用仍然未被充分探索。我們介紹了一個初步基準數據集，即 ASURRE，旨在捕捉 AI 輔助調查參與的使用策略，這些策略範圍從完全生成和修訂到基於角色的代理完成。在這些策略的控制下，使用多個 LLM 在三個不同學科的真實世界調查中生成 LLM 輔助的調查回應，並與真實的人類回應配對。我們對現有機器生成文本 (MGT) 檢測器的評估顯示，天真的 AI 使用是容易檢測的，而模仿整個受訪者的基於角色的代理則使檢測器的性能接近隨機。我們進一步顯示，代理完成無法完全複製受訪者級別的行為，並留下獨特的行為痕跡。雖然可以通過有針對性的提示來繞過個別線索，但對這些線索進行簡單的少量樣本、無需訓練的聚合器，能使平均 AUROC 在代理設置中提高 +0.14，相較於最佳現有檢測器。我們的項目可在 https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE 獲得。
